page_title: BET 1-1 RAY | Betis v Rayo Vallecano 22/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+4' Victor Garcia shows a yellow card to Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) for his blatant foul.
90+3' Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
90+1' Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
88' The number of shots on goal at present is 5:4.
86' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Juanmi, but Augusto Batalla displays great awareness to stop him.
85' Juanmi (Betis) is adjudged offside.
84' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Cedric Bakambu (Betis) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Vitor Roque trots off the pitch and is replaced by Cedric Bakambu (Betis).
81' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
81' Inigo Perez has decided to make a change. Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) replaces Adrian Embarba.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Oscar Trejo (Rayo Vallecano) comes onto the pitch for Isi Palazon.
81' Substitution. Abde Ezzalzouli is replaced by Juanmi (Betis).
81' The attendance for today's match is 53121.
80' Romain Perraud (Betis) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and has an effort on goal. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies inches high over the bar.
79' Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano) is able to continue to play.
77' Augusto Batalla (Rayo Vallecano) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
76' A snap shot by Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Francisco Vieites produces a good save to thwart him.
76' Vitor Roque (Betis) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A fortuitous save from Augusto Batalla stops the ball from going into the middle of the goal.
75' Today's match ends for Youssouf Sabaly who will be replaced by Aitor Ruibal (Betis).
75' The linesman signals that Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
73' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
71' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) is caught offside!
68' Assane Diao (Betis) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
66' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Sergi Altimira as he is replaced by Assane Diao (Betis).
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Isco leaves the pitch and Pablo Fornals (Betis) comes on.
66' It is time for a substitution. Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano) is on for Randy Nteka.
66' Inigo Perez has decided to substitute Unai Lopez and he is replaced by Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano).
64' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
60' Total attempts – 10:7.
57' Vitor Roque (Betis) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the left post.
55' Vitor Roque (Betis) sets himself up on the edge of the box, but balloons his shot way over the bar.
54' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) wins a header inside the box after a cross and steers it goalwards, but Augusto Batalla produces a wonderful reflex save.
54' Some neat passing and movement from Betis as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
51' 1 - 1 What a beauty from just outside the box! Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power inside the right post.
50' Sergi Altimira (Betis) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Victor Garcia blows for a foul.
49' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) beats the defender to the lofted pass inside the box, but can't control his shot and it flashes high over the bar.
48' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Victor Garcia no option but to blow his whistle.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Problems for Inigo Perez as Alvaro Garcia is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) replaces him.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' The game is interrupted now, Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
44' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) sends a long ball in, but Francisco Vieites comfortably gathers the ball.
42' Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
41' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
41' The shots on goal statistics – 2:0.
39' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano).
37' 1 - 0 Goal! Isco (Betis) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Augusto Batalla into the bottom right corner.
37' Isco (Betis) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
36' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
36' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Victor Garcia signals. The referee points to the penalty spot. PENALTY to Betis!
34' Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
32' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Adrian Embarba (Rayo Vallecano) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
30' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
30' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
28' Isco (Betis) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
27' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) has tested the patience of referee Victor Garcia and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
25' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 5:4.
24' Marc Bartra (Betis) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
21' Vitor Roque (Betis) is flagged for offside.
20' Florian Lejeune (Rayo Vallecano) is penalised for holding. Victor Garcia signals a set piece.
19' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) will deliver the corner kick.
19' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) inside the box.
16' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) will take the corner.
16' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
15' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) takes the corner but it's cleared.
12' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) sends a chip pass into the box, but Augusto Batalla is quickest to intercept the ball.
12' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
10' A loose ball is pounced on by Johnny Cardoso (Betis) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Augusto Batalla is alert and makes a comfortable save.
10' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
9' Betis players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
6' Vitor Roque (Betis) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
5' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
5' Vitor Roque (Betis) tackles a bit over-zealously and Victor Garcia blows for a foul.
3' The resulting corner, taken by Isco (Betis), comes to nothing.
3' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
2' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Betis.
2' Vitor Roque (Betis) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Augusto Batalla has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Rayo Vallecano will have the kick-off.
Victor Garcia will referee today's match.
